name: Cetinje (Montenegro)
description: A red field charged at the centre with a white Greek cross.
history: The statute of the Old Royal Capital of Cetinje defines its flag as the traditional Krstaš flag — the red flag with a white cross carried by Montenegrin armies at Vučji Do in 1876 — in proportions 1:2. The date the clause was adopted is not recorded; the statute was amended on 27 October 2010.

features.symbolism: the Krstaš-barjak, the traditional Montenegrin war flag
